# AAC tone provenance

`aac_tones.h` contains original synthetic audio generated by
`tools/make_aac_tones.cpp`, copyright 2026 Rajinder Singh,
GPL-2.0-or-later. Mono input is a 440 Hz sine at 44.1 kHz; stereo input is
440 Hz left and 880 Hz right at 48 kHz, peak amplitude 8192 in signed 16-bit
PCM. Input length is eight 1024-sample blocks, followed by encoder drain.

The Windows Media Foundation AAC-LC encoder produced the ADTS bytes; no media
was downloaded or copied from a game. Tests check source tone frequencies,
amplitude and channel order, not just a nonempty decoder result.

To regenerate in a Windows x64 compiler environment:

```powershell
clang-cl /std:c++20 /EHsc tools/make_aac_tones.cpp /Febuild/make-aac-tones.exe /link mfplat.lib mf.lib mfuuid.lib wmcodecdspuuid.lib ole32.lib
build/make-aac-tones.exe tests/fixtures/aac_tones.h
```

Encoder output can vary across Windows implementations. CI uses the committed
fixtures and does not need the Windows encoder. No binary executable is shipped
with these fixtures.
